guideContent.strategyOverview: Rakdos group slug that deals damage to all opponents whenever anyone does anything. The Lord of Pain prevents opponent lifegain and deals damage equal to the first spell cast each turn to a chosen player. A dense web of cheap punishers (Eidolon of the Great Revel, Pyrostatic Pillar, Harsh Mentor, Kederekt Parasite) ensures damage starts flowing from turns 1-2, while damage multipliers like Fiery Emancipation, Solphim, and Twinflame Tyrant stack to turn those pings into lethal threats. Artist's Talent at Level 3 adds +2 noncombat damage per source, stacking with Torture Pit for devastating amplification. Valgavoth draws cards whenever opponents lose life on their turns, providing a card advantage engine alongside the pain.

winConditions.title: Heartless Hidetsugu Lethal Activation
winConditions.description: Activate Heartless Hidetsugu to deal half each player's life total as damage. With any damage doubler (Solphim, Dictate of the Twin Gods, or Fiery Emancipation), the damage equals or exceeds their life total. Lethal to all opponents at even life totals. Stay at odd life to survive. Twinflame Tyrant doubles only opponent damage for a safer kill.

winConditions.title: Peer into the Abyss Kill
winConditions.description: Target an opponent with Peer into the Abyss to halve their life and draw half their library. Sheoldred deals 2 per card drawn, Underworld Dreams deals 1 per draw. With 20+ cards drawn, Sheoldred alone adds 40 damage on top of the life halving. Any single draw punisher alongside Peer is lethal.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Strategic win path identification

winConditions.title: Repercussion Board Wipe
winConditions.description: Blasphemous Act deals 13 damage to each creature. Repercussion redirects that damage to each creature's controller. Two creatures per opponent means 26 damage each. With Fiery Emancipation tripling your damage sources, that becomes 78 per opponent. Careful positioning required since your own creatures also trigger Repercussion.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Strategic win path identification

winConditions.title: Damage Multiplier Stack
winConditions.description: Stack multiple damage multipliers so that every ping becomes lethal. The Lord of Pain's 5-damage trigger becomes 10 with Solphim, 30 with Fiery Emancipation, then Wound Reflection doubles all life loss at end step. Two multipliers plus Wound Reflection turns any damage source into a kill. Even a single fetchland activation from an opponent under Ankh of Mishra cascades into massive life loss.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Strategic win path identification

winConditions.title: Bolas's Citadel Life Storm
winConditions.description: Cast spells from library top by paying life instead of mana. Chain low-cost spells to deal incremental damage through punisher effects. Activate Citadel's ability to sacrifice 10 nonland permanents and deal 10 damage to each opponent. With Wound Reflection, that 10 becomes 20 at end step. Even without the activated ability, chaining 5-6 spells from library top with damage multipliers active is often lethal.

synergies.title: Peer into the Abyss + Draw Punishers
synergies.description: Target draws half library (~20 cards) and loses half life (~20). With Sheoldred alone: 20 draws x 2 life loss = 40 + 20 half-life = 60. Lethal. With Dreams + Sheoldred: 20 x 3 + 20 = 80. With full punisher package (6 sources): 20 x 7 + 20 = 160. Even targeting yourself is viable — draw 20 cards, lose 20 life, refuel completely.

synergies.title: Spell Punisher Stack (Eidolon + Pillar)
synergies.description: Both deal 2 damage per spell with CMC ≤ 3. Together, every cheap spell costs the caster 4 life. Most Commander spells are CMC 3 or less. With Solphim doubling: 8 per cheap spell. With Fiery Emancipation tripling: 12 per spell. The Lord of Pain prevents lifegain recovery.

synergies.title: Artist's Talent L3 + Torture Pit
synergies.description: Both add +2 noncombat damage per source to opponents. Together, every ping source deals +4 extra damage. Eidolon's 2 becomes 6, Underworld Dreams' 1 becomes 5 per draw. Stacks multiplicatively with Solphim/Fiery Emancipation on top.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Additive damage bonuses that stack with multiplicative doublers

synergies.title: Harsh Mentor vs Activated Abilities
synergies.description: 2 damage whenever an opponent activates a non-mana ability of an artifact, creature, or land. Punishes: equipment (equip), vehicles (crew), fetchlands, cycling, sacrifice outlets, Treasure tokens. 2 CMC deployment means it's online before most activated abilities matter. With Solphim: 4 per activation.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Covers activation-based game actions that other punishers miss

synergies.title: Maddening Hex (Self-Bouncing Curse)
synergies.description: Enchants an opponent; each noncreature spell they cast rolls d6 damage (avg 3.5) then bounces to a random other opponent. Effectively punishes ALL opponents' noncreature spells without needing multiple copies. Cannot be easily removed since it moves to a new player each trigger.
